objective: Generate a sub-three-minute PPT-led Chinese narrated competition video interleaved with six verified product operations and sentence-level subtitles.

iterations.finding: Natural-length narration would exceed the 180-second competition limit.
iterations.resolution: Removed repeated wording while preserving meaning, audience, step purpose, result and evidence boundary.

iterations.finding: Chinese subtitles rendered as missing-glyph boxes because the libass family name did not match the font internal name.
iterations.resolution: Used the converted font's internal family name Noto Sans SC Thin.

iterations.finding: SRT subtitles were scaled larger than expected and covered the operation recording.
iterations.resolution: Calibrated the measured libass scale to FontSize 14, Outline 1.3 and MarginV 10.

iterations.finding: Chinese subtitles stay within the dedicated 120-pixel zone; restrained emphasis blocks, PPT, operation recording and explanation rail remain legible.

evidenceBoundary: This proves a reproducible technical demonstration and presentation artifact, not official competition scoring or long-term business productivity.
